description:
"Summon an explosive rune under an enemy that etches foes nearby with scrawled glyphs, dealing |cffffff15235|r Magic Damage over |cffffff20|r seconds.

The rune lingers on the initial target for |cffffff6|r seconds before detonating, dealing |cffffff5288|r Frost Damage to enemies within 7 meters. Rune detonation cannot be primed with Fulminating Rune again for |cffffff6|r seconds.

Up to 3 allies near the initial target can activate the Runebreak synergy, dealing |cffffff9914|r Frost Damage to enemies within 7 meters."
